name: traefik-geoip-filter
description: A Docker container that works as a GeoIP allow/blocklist middleware for Traefik. Uses the Maxmind GeoLite2 database.

variables.name: MaxMind license key
variables.description: The MaxMind license key you generated

variables.name: Filter type
variables.description: Set the filter as an allow or blocklist (possible values: allow, blocklist)

variables.name: Country codes
variables.description: List of countries you want to allow/block IPs from, separated by spaces. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2#Officially_assigned_code_elements

variables.name: Sub codes
variables.description: List of locations smaller than a country that you want to allow/block IPs from. Separated by spaces. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2#Current_codes

variables.name: Extra IPs
variables.description: Append additional IPs to the filter list, separated by spaces. E.g. LAN, Vaultwarden network. E.g. 10.0.0.0/32 172.16.0.0/16 192.168.0.0/24. Optional.
